subject: [ARM] Unaligned access fixes
change_summary: Changes ARM unaligned-read selection and alignment representation.

units.name: Changes ARM unaligned-read selection and alignment representation.
units.evidence: Four ARMv6/v7 matrices prove 21 fixed public cases each; the 200-byte XXH3 target does not reach a return in source IR. x86 control proves all 22.

notes: The verdict covers only the indicated targets and configurations; inconclusive cases are not counted as equivalence.
